issue.mint_text: BSP / Philippine mint · small mark by talons (soft on photo)

C163.notes: SER AS-PH-002. Reverse Philippine Eagle (Pithecophaga jefferyi) wings spread · 50 SENTIMO · scientific name on rim · user shorthand 1984 ph + photo (obverse/date side not shown — Joseph dated 1984). Marcos-era copper-nickel — jeepney / sari-sari odd-change while the critically endangered eagle rode the nation’s small money. Country #26 — first actual Philippines flip. SER sibling: AS-PH-001. Philippines flips now 2.

issue.mint_text: Manila / BSP era (no letter on shown portrait side)

C246.notes: SER AS-PH-001. Photo confirmed · user shorthand 1971. Portrait side Francisco Baltazar (Balagtas) left · SAMPUNG SENTIMOS · big 10 (arms / date reverse not shown — Joseph dated 1971). Pilipino Series aluminum — jeepney / sari-sari odd-change while the poet of Florante at Laura rode every ten-sentimo piece. Second Philippines after eagle C163 / AS-PH-002 (1984 50 Sentimo); earlier on the ladder. Philippines flips now 2.
